title: Royal Garden Blues, Clarence Williams and Pete Lala's
summary: They discuss who wrote Royal Garden Blues. Billy says Clarence Williams wrote it and Mary sang it at Pete Lala's cabaret, then featured it at the Monogram and the Royal Garden with Oliver, Armstrong and Lil.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Garden Blues, now uh. Clarence Williams wrote that. Yes, Clarence Williams, he wrote that. And I, uh, they,

I featured it before it was published. You know, when I first met Jimmy Noon, or one of the first times I saw him back about 1937 or 38, I'm quite sure Jimmy told me that he helped write that, that they, he and Joe Oliver and some members of the band worked that out. Yes, yes. Over at Royal Garden. At the Royal Garden. But Clarence Williams, I guess, bought it and published it. Did you know anything about it? No, no, no, no.
He didn't buy it. He wrote that, and she sung it at Pete Lalla's Cabaret. Clarence Williams really worked on the number of that.
stuff Then I featured it here on the stage at the Money Graham and Joe Oliver and then there's St. Louis Armstrong and Lil and all of those people at the Royal Garden and that's where we featured it.
